chunks: And in the narration of Ḥarīz, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
“When the muḥrim performs ghusl from janābah, he pours water over his head and separates the hair with his fingertips, some of it from some.”

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: How should a muhrim perform ghusl for janabah while in ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about how a muhrim should perform ghusl for janabah while in ihram. It indicates that pouring water over the head and separating the hair with the fingers is permitted in this state.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2707 - In the narration of Hariz from Abu Abdullah (as), Imam (as) said:

"When a person in the state of ihram performs ghusl (ritual bath) for janabah (major ritual impurity), they should pour water over their head and separate their hair with their fingers, parting it gently."
